speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a child with a 3-week history of fatigue, fever, easy bruising, and severe leg pain. To understand the cause of your leg pain and bruising, can you tell me how severe the pain is on a scale of 1 to 10, and does it get worse when you walk or press on the area?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Leukemia (likely ALL).

Based on the 3-week history of fatigue, bruising, fever, and severe night pain in a 4-year-old, this is highly suggestive of a bone marrow failure process. I need to confirm the presence of lymphadenopathy or hepatosplenomegaly. Please tell me if you have noticed any swollen lymph nodes in her neck, armpits, or groin, or if her belly seems enlarged.
